title: How Datadog resolves evolving OpenTelemetry semantics at query time
summary: OpenTelemetry conventions evolve, but queries still need to work across old, current, and Datadog-native telemetry. Learn how Datadog uses a knowledge graph and query-time translation to resolve conditional semantic equivalences and validate them against real data.

title: How we scaled metrics aggregation by moving durable state into storage
summary: Learn how Datadog evolved metrics aggregation from fixed partition ownership to transferable state and, ultimately, storage-side reconciliation.
